description: A -100 to +100 score for one coin from fixed, published rules over trend, 24h momentum, RSI, funding, open interest, account crowding, Fear & Greed and major news, with each component's input and points and a label (strong_bearish to strong_bullish). Use as one input to your own decision and show the components. Not for placing orders (use preview_perp_order); not advice or a forecast. Input: symbol (base coin). Rules in method. Next: size_position_by_risk.
